method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Asian stocks bounce back as Mideast mediation takes oil lower
Equities.reason: Risk-on bounce as mediation reduces oil risk premium; supports regional equity indices and risk appetite. Relevant to broad market sentiment but regionally focused, so medium relevance.

Equities.title: Stocks Rise as Chipmakers Extend Rebound, Oil Dips: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Chipmakers leading a rebound reinforces AI/hardware leadership narrative that is driving broad market flows; oil easing removes a tail-risk. High relevance given tech's market leadership.

Equities.title: Nasdaq Loses Early Gains as Fears Persist Over Oil Prices, AI
Equities.reason: Mix of renewed oil/geopolitical fears and lingering AI-related uncertainty hitting the Nasdaq—negative for tech-led indices; typical daily market swing so moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Indian shares set to open lower on firmer oil
Equities.reason: Higher oil creates cost/headline pressure for Indian equities and regional risk-off; relevant but regional/single-market in scope so lower relevance.

Equities.title: Jamie Dimon says markets underestimate risks and he wouldn't buy stocks or Treasurys at current prices
Equities.summary: Comments from JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon contrast with investors' recent willingness to look past wars, tariffs and other shocks.
Equities.reason: High-profile CEO warning increases downside risk perception across markets; carries above-average relevance for sentiment and positioning given Dimon's influence.

Equities.title: Stock futures climb as traders shift focus to earnings amid Middle East tensions
Equities.reason: Futures rally indicates tactical risk-on as earnings take center stage despite geopolitical backdrop; relevant to near-term market positioning.

Equities.title: Wall Street indexes fall, with Iran and earnings season in focus
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation (Iran) dragging indices lower as investors weigh earnings risk; broad-market implication gives it elevated relevance.

Equities.title: China Unleashes Broad State Support to Halt Tech Stock Selloff
Equities.reason: Explicit state intervention to stabilize tech signals a major regime/support for Chinese tech equities and global risk assets; high relevance as it alters market structure and flow dynamics.

Equities.title: Korean Stock Traders Slash Margin Loans to Lowest Since April
Equities.reason: Reduction in retail leverage is a risk-off microstructure signal that can amplify downside during shocks; regionally relevant to Asian equity flows.

Equities.title: US to hit Canada with 50% tariffs on wide range of goods
Equities.summary: Washington accuses neighbour of engaging in unfair practices in move that could reignite trade war
Equities.reason: Large, unexpected tariffs materially raise trade policy risk and could hit cross-border supply chains and corporate profits; high-impact macro risk for broad equities.

Equities.title: S&P Slips as Apple, Tesla Keep Broader Chipmaker Gains in Check
Equities.reason: Market breadth constrained by mega-cap moves despite chip strength; signals tech concentration risk but is more of a market-internal nuance so lower relevance.

Equities.title: AMD launches Helios, its first rack AI system to rival Nvidia, adding Microsoft as newest buyer
Equities.summary: AMD is taking aim at Nvidia with Helios, its first AI rack system, and has landed Microsoft as a new customer, joining Meta, OpenAI and Oracle.
Equities.reason: Concrete product wins and competition in AI hardware support the broader AI leadership theme powering tech equity flows; directly relevant to sector leadership dynamics.

Equities.title: Another Tanker Hit in Hormuz as Houthis Add to Regional Risks
Equities.reason: Escalation in shipping lane attacks raises oil/insurance risk premia and global growth fears—negative for risk assets and market sentiment with above-average relevance.

Rates.title: New Zealand’s Faster Inflation Bolsters Case for More Rate Hikes
Rates.reason: Stronger NZ inflation raises odds of further RBNZ tightening — direct upward pressure on local and potentially global yields (hawkish inflation signal). High relevance given direct monetary policy implications.

Rates.title: RBNZ Sectoral Factor Inflation Model holds steady at 2.7% YoY in Q2 2026
Rates.summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) published its Sectoral Factor Model Inflation gauge for the second quarter of 2026, following the release of the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) by NZ Stats on Tuesday.
Rates.reason: Inflation gauge steady but elevated supports a hawkish RBNZ stance vs. easing — modest upward pressure on NZ rates / sovereign curve.

Rates.title: Inflation fears are back in the spotlight as the Middle East conflict keeps oil prices elevated, analysts say
Rates.summary: Inflation fears are back in focus amid worries over escalating tensions between the U.S. and Iran in the Middle East conflict which has kept oil prices elevated
Rates.reason: Geopolitical-driven oil price risk lifts inflation expectations — typically negative for bonds as it raises the prospect of higher-for-longer rates.

Rates.title: Money Funds Keep Cash Closer as Fed Leaves Markets Guessing
Rates.reason: Funds holding cash amid Fed uncertainty suggests reduced duration demand and upward pressure on short-end yields; signals market caution on policy path.

Rates.title: Japan Insurers Buy Most Super-Long Bonds in Three Years in June
Rates.reason: Material buyer demand for super-long JGBs is supportive for long-end bond prices (pushes yields down) — a clear localized positive for rates (JGB curve).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.reason: Fed discount rate minutes can shift market expectations about backstop/streetside policy tools and near-term tightening bias — modest negative for bonds if read as precautionary/hawkish.

Rates.title: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened
Rates.reason: ECB survey noting tighter lending conditions is consistent with restrictive monetary effects and may keep euro-area yields supported vs. easing expectations.

Rates.title: UK Unemployment Rate steadies at 4.9% in May vs. 5.0% expected
Rates.summary: The United Kingdom’s (UK) ILO Unemployment Rate remained steady at 4.9% in the three months to May after reporting 4.9% in the previous reading, data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Tuesday. The data came in below the market con
Rates.reason: Labour market slightly firmer-than-expected supports a less dovish BoE narrative — modest upward pressure on gilt yields given policy sensitivity to employment.

FX.title: US Dollar: Fed inflation framework questions – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur discusses how persistent high Oil and energy prices complicate the Federal Reserve’s stance, with markets only modestly pricing in further tightening.
FX.reason: Commerzbank flags that markets are only modestly pricing further Fed tightening amid sticky energy prices — a narrative that leans toward USD downside (weaker dollar vs major FX). Moderately relevant for USD direction.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds ground near 101.00 amid rising safe-haven demand
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is remaining in the positive territory and trading around 101.00 during the Asian session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: DXY holding ~101 with rising safe-haven demand signals broad USD strength versus major currencies — a clear negative for non-USD pairs and a high-relevance USD-centric market impulse.

FX.title: US CENTCOM: Latest strikes hit Iran’s military command centres and air defense systems
FX.summary: The US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced via a post on the social media platform, X, that they completed the latest strikes at 1AM GMT Tuesday.
FX.reason: Confirmed US military strikes raise geopolitical risk and are driving safe-haven USD demand — a strong market-moving driver for FX (pushes USD higher / other majors lower).

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8110 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Pair-level confirmation that safe-haven flows are lifting the USD versus CHF. Useful corroborating signal for USD-strength narrative; technical/pair move so moderate relevance.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bears retain control below 200-SMA on H4; break of 1.1400 awaited
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair is seen consolidating during the Asian session on Tuesday and trading just above the 1.1400 mark, or a four-day low touched the previous day.
FX.reason: Technical EUR/USD note showing EUR weakness below key SMA — implies USD strength. As a price-forecast/technical piece, assigned capped relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar strengthens above 0.7000 despite rising US-Iran tensions
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair drifts higher to near 0.7010 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. However, the potential upside for the pair might be limited amid the escalation of the US-Iran conflict. The Australian employment report will take center stage later on T
FX.reason: AUD strength vs USD is a notable counter-signal to the broader safe-haven dollar bid (driven by local risk sentiment/RBA differentials and domestic data). Treated as an idiosyncratic but relevant partial offset.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains support amid financial hub plans, geopolitical tensions ease
FX.summary: USD/IDR continues its losing streak for the sixth successive day, trading around 17,940 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: USD/IDR decline signals EM/local factors and risk-on flows reducing USD demand vs IDR. Relevant as an EM counterpoint but lower relevance to the global USD narrative.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: Direct EIA note that Strait of Hormuz disruptions raised oil price volatility and supported higher crude — clear supply-risk driven bullish signal for the oil complex. High relevance because it's a broad, macro supply shock affecting physical flows.

Commodities.title: Goldman Says Brent Could Top $120 If Hormuz Disruptions Persist
Commodities.reason: Major bank price forecast tying continued Hormuz disruptions to a materially higher Brent — reinforces a strong upside risk premium for crude. Forecast from a high-profile house raises market impact and relevance.

Commodities.title: Iran's Houthi allies declare maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia, escalating threat to oil market
Commodities.summary: The militants, in a statement carried by state news, accused the Saudis of laying an "aggressive siege" against them.
Commodities.reason: New maritime embargo escalates physical risk to shipping lanes and crude flows — strong positive for oil risk premium and prices. High relevance given direct supply/transport implications for the oil market.

Commodities.title: Ships shun Strait of Hormuz as renewed fighting strains key oil corridor
Commodities.summary: Vessel traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has slumped since U.S. President Donald Trump's blockade took effect last week.
Commodities.reason: Reports of shipping activity declines through the Strait imply immediate choke points for crude/product flows — bullish for oil prices due to tighter effective supply and rerouting costs. Strong near-term relevance.

Commodities.title: What are tank bottoms?
Commodities.summary: Crude oil inventories held at storage facilities in Cushing, Oklahoma, fell below 20 million barrels during the week ending June 19 until the week ending July 10, according to our Weekly Petroleum Status Report.
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing Cushing stocks below key levels signals physical inventory drawdown — supportive for WTI/physical crude differentials. Relevant fundamental inventory signal for oil pricing.

Commodities.title: Why are gasoline prices rising faster than oil prices? Blame it on the ‘crack.’
Commodities.reason: Stronger gasoline/cash crack spreads relative to crude indicate refining-side tightness or seasonal demand — positive for refined products and implies upside to gasoline prices even if crude moves pause. Moderate relevance (product-specific).

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Gain as Traders Weigh Outlook for Middle East Conflict
Commodities.reason: Newsflow that oil is holding gains while markets reprice Middle East conflict risk — confirms the prevailing supply-risk-driven bullish tone for crude markets. Broad market commentary → high relevance.

Commodities.title: Brent: Geopolitics weigh on prices – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note Brent retreated below $90/bbl as hopes for US–Iran de-escalation offset rising supply risks. They highlight reports of a proposed 10‑day ceasefire and ongoing large divisions between the US and Iran.
Commodities.reason: Counter-signal: IGn notes de‑escalation hopes pushed Brent down below $90, tempering the pure supply-risk narrative. Included as a lower-relevance dissenting data point; mildly bearish for near-term prices.

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade volumes reflect strong global demand and growing U.S. export capacity — modestly supportive for global gas/LNG pricing and flows. Moderate relevance (structural market signal rather than immediate shock).

Commodities.title: Gold jumps to nearly one-week top as Iran diplomacy hopes undermine USD despite Fed bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its intraday ascent and jumps to a four-day high, near the $4,075 region heading into the European session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Gold moving higher on continued Middle East tensions and USD dynamics — classic safe-haven response. Reasonable relevance given geopolitics and FX transmission into bullion demand.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD surges to near $58.20 as oil price rally hits pause
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up over 3% to near $58.20 during the early European trading session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Silver up materially intraday — metal often tracks gold and real rates; this is a price-move piece (technical/short-term) so relevance is moderate but positive given risk-off/precious-metals demand.

Commodities.title: Gold prices today, Monday, July 20, 2026: Gold holds above $4,000 despite continued violence in the Middle East
Commodities.reason: Daily price update showing gold resilience above $4k amid Middle East violence — supportive but it's a routine price bulletin, so lower relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver prices today, Monday, July 20, 2026: Silver ticks up after violent weekend in Middle East
Commodities.reason: Routine silver price update linking a small uptick to Middle East violence — positive for precious metals but modest relevance as it's a short-form price note.

Crypto.title: Tether's USDT hits 2-year countdown threatening its position on U.S. crypto platforms
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin regulatory/legal uncertainty around USDT poses material liquidity and access risk for U.S. exchanges and trading venues — large negative for crypto market plumbing and price formation.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs see new money again, but inflows remain ‘peanuts’ relative to the recent exodus
Crypto.reason: Renewed ETF inflows are supportive for BTC demand and institutional adoption, but small size limits immediate bullish impact — modest positive.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin hits a two-week high near $65,500 as the chip trade turns back into a tailwind
Crypto.reason: Price momentum and correlation with broader risk-on flows (chip trade) indicate improved BTC market sentiment — routine positive market-price news.

Crypto.title: A bitcoin 'volmageddon' may be brewing, key indicator suggests
Crypto.reason: Warnings about a derivatives-driven volatility cascade (volmageddon) raise downside tail-risk for leveraged positions and market stability — meaningful negative for near-term liquidity.

Crypto.title: Cross-chain protocol Allbridge halts after $1.65 million flash loan exploit
Crypto.reason: A hack/flash-loan exploit on a cross-chain bridge undermines DeFi security confidence and can pressure risk assets and TVL — clear negative for crypto trust and flows.

Crypto.title: Bank of Korea prepares for live CBDC transactions with 9 banks in September
Crypto.reason: Progress toward live CBDC testing with commercial banks signals central-bank digital currency adoption and institutional integration of digital rails — positive structural development for digital-asset infrastructure.

Crypto.title: UK Parliament begins inquiry into banking chokepoint for crypto businesses
Crypto.reason: A parliamentary inquiry targeting banking access issues could reduce a major operational barrier for crypto firms in the UK, easing friction for exchanges and services — modestly positive for industry growth.

Crypto.title: Brazil’s securities regulator sets up task force with 60-day deadline for tokenization proposal
Crypto.reason: Regulatory focus on tokenization in a major emerging market suggests potential for clearer frameworks and product expansion — positive but jurisdiction-specific and limited near-term impact.

Crypto.title: Crypto market slips even as equities advance. Pump surges on social-media chatter
Crypto.reason: Divergence between equities and crypto, and retail-driven pumps on social media, point to speculative retail volatility and selective weakness — small negative for market stability.
